ety.text: Inherited from Proto-New Indo-Aryan *अट्टक्कला (aṭṭakkalā). Cognate with Assamese আঁটকাল (ãtokal), Bengali আটকাল (aṭkal), Gujarati અટકળ (aṭakaḷ), Marathi अटकळ (aṭkaḷ), and Odia ଅଟକଳ (aṭakaḷa).
From आज (āj) + कल (kal). Compare with Gujarati આજકાલ (ājakāl), Marathi आजकाल (āj̈kāl).
Learned borrowing from Sanskrit आयाम (āyāma), ultimately from the root आयम् (āyam), which is from आ- (ā-) + यम् (yam).
